name: own-base-mlx-tiny-state-bridge-v1
scope: CPU-only tiny feasibility, no live checkpoint load or migration; no GPU/full model/pretrained weights.
exact_requirements: Torch-to-MLX-to-neutral full tensor roundtrip exact at step3.
MLX uninterrupted step3to8 vs fresh process restore step5to8: all weights,moments,groupstep,groupLR,explicitMLXkey,preservedTorchRNG,cursor exactly equal.
Losses and PRNG canaries after resume exactly equal.
Seven negative controls all refuse: corrupt bytes,missing moment,wrong optimizer step,missing RNG,wrong cursor,wrong decay,wrong experiment.
rng_policy: Torch RNG preserved opaquely; assign explicit new MLXkey [0,seed], verify native key encoding; use canaries each update, no claim random stream equivalence between frameworks. No dropout/random training operations.
source_policy: Reuse previous own-random tiny parameter fixtures; independently fixed random token matrices, no protected or live data.
notes: Fixed tolerances before execution; preserve failure instead of tuning gates.
Constant learning rate only; global campaign scheduler and crash controller not implemented.
Native MLXoptimizer state setter used; two native groups with explicit biascorrection.
